teachingReview.heading: Protect release-system integrity
teachingReview.body: Matrix, membrane, and osmotic systems control input rate. Crushing, chewing, splitting, or opening can defeat that control, so dosage-form manipulation follows exact manufacturer instructions rather than molecule-level intuition. The book identifies Ditropan XL as an osmotic-release oxybutynin product that can leave an empty shell in the stool. A visible ghost shell can remain after the drug has been released; it does not by itself show that the full dose was lost. Use this product-specific counseling example without assuming that every extended-release product uses the same delivery system.

teachingReview.body: Alprostadil is prostaglandin E1 delivered directly through intracavernosal injection or a urethral system. It activates prostaglandin receptors and raises cAMP in smooth muscle, producing relaxation without requiring nitric oxide or PDE5 inhibition. Route, titration, penile pain, fibrosis, hypotension, bleeding, and the four-hour emergency threshold remain product and patient specific.

teachingReview.heading: Separate international from US use
teachingReview.body: Duloxetine is an SNRI whose aromatic and amine features support serotonin and norepinephrine transporter inhibition after oral exposure. It has been used for stress urinary incontinence outside the United States, but current US duloxetine labeling does not include that indication. A mechanistic rationale or foreign approval is not a US indication.
